text:
No option can be put forward from this run because the churn limit was not scored.

- The model compared £49, £54 and £59, and the comparison held up under the changes tested; however, it cannot assess compliance with **monthly churn <4%**. That constraint is therefore excluded, not satisfied.
- The £20k MRR target also could not be evaluated as a level because the model has no recorded MRR baseline or target frame. The comparison is consequently relative, not evidence that any option reaches £20k.
- The result rests materially on Olumi estimates for Pro subscriber base, new Pro sign-ups, monthly churn, and feature-release value; their calibration is provisional.
